videos.title: I can type at 156 words per minute 🤯
videos.description:
I can type at 156 words per minute, which I thought was fast until I timed myself speaking instead.

If you’d like a free 30-day trial of Wispr Flow Pro, visit: https://ref.wisprflow.ai/ali_instagram

I gave Claude a whole prompt about planning a 20-person team offsite in Thailand, Airbnbs, activities, the works, and it took about 20 seconds to say out loud. Typing that would've taken way longer.

The tool I've been using is called Wispr Flow and it's genuinely changed how I interact with my computer. It works in literally every app, Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, Slack, emails, whatever. Anywhere you'd normally type, you just speak instead.

And before you say "just use Siri dictation" - I've tried. Built-in dictation makes loads of mistakes and doesn't clean anything up. Wispr Flow is fast, almost never gets things wrong, and it actually turns the way you speak into text that's ready to send. Capitalises proper nouns, removes the ums and ahs, all of it.
